title: Exactness of the named concrete Kummer complex
statement: For every Kummer datum k [def-sp-tower-class-systems], its actual named complex towerKummerComplex [def-sfb-canonical-kummer-complex] is short exact. The assertion has no additional hypothesis.

source.place: clause (2), evaluation gives the finite Kummer first Chern class; expanded SmoothPurityTowerClasses proof, steps 5--8

proof.text: The named complex has the same three objects and two maps as the complex in k.exact. The two zero-morphism witnesses are definitionally equal, and the zero-composite proof is proof irrelevant. Therefore the exact field of k proves the assertion.
